valueChange.when: The user selects another tab (pointer, an arrow key with automatic activation, Enter or Space).
valueChange.payload: The value of the selected tab.

rules: Arrange leading, label and trailing in that order, centered in the block dimension; label is required plain text in typography on one line, never truncated, and is the accessible name of the tab. leading holds at most one decorative icon of iconSize; trailing holds at most one Counter or Badge (a count of items in the panel, a New badge), sized by the tab.
The tab block size is minHeight; paddingInline on both sides, gap between parts, radius corners for its surface.

An unselected tab paints its label and icon in idleColor in the default interaction and in content otherwise; a selected tab paints them in content. interaction resolves in this order: disabled, hover, default; hover is the pointer over the tab, painting surface behind it.

The selected tab shows indicator, a bar of indicatorThickness in indicatorColor on the edge that faces the panels (the block end of a horizontal list, the inline end of a vertical list), over the list's line. Selection is never conveyed by color alone.
A disabled tab is shown in the disabled colors, cannot be selected, and is skipped by the arrow keys.
Colors and the indicator change over motionDuration with easingStandard; no transition under reduced motion.

Each panel holds the free content of the tab with the same value; only the panel of the selected tab is shown, the others are hidden from every user. The panel is exposed as a tab panel named by its tab. When its content has no focusable element, the panel itself is a stop in sequential focus after the list and shows the focus indicator of the tabs.

contrast.note: The label on its own surface in each interaction; disabled values are informational.

rules: Tabs show one of several panels of related content at a time in the same place (sections of a settings page, views of a record), with a list of tabs to switch between them. They do not navigate to another page (that is a navigation menu with links), do not hold a form choice (that is a RadioGroup or a SegmentedControl) and never hide steps of a sequence.

list is exposed as a tab list named by label when it is non-empty; each trigger is a tab exposing whether it is selected and which panel it controls. There is always exactly one selected tab: value names it; when value matches no enabled tab, the first enabled tab is selected.

orientation horizontal places the tabs in a row in source order, separated by listGap, above the panels, with a line of lineThickness in lineColor along the list's block end across the whole width; panels start panelGap below the list. orientation vertical stacks the tabs at the inline start, each as wide as the widest tab, with the line along the list's inline end; panels start panelGap after the list.
When a horizontal list does not fit its inline size, it scrolls inline and keeps the focused tab and the selected tab visible; tabs never wrap or shrink.

Focus: the list is one stop in sequential focus, landing on the selected tab; Tab from the list moves to the selected panel (or its first focusable element). The roving focus rules are shared with Toolbar: in a horizontal list Right and Left Arrow (reversed in right-to-left text) move focus to the next and previous enabled tab, wrapping at the ends; in a vertical list Down and Up Arrow do; Home and End move it to the first and last enabled tab; disabled tabs are skipped.

With activation automatic, moving focus to a tab selects it; with activation manual, focus moves without selecting and Enter or Space selects the focused tab (for panels that are slow to show). A pointer press on an enabled tab selects it and focuses it. Selecting a tab emits valueChange when the value changed.
Each tab, and each panel that takes focus, shows a focus indicator of focusWidth in focusColor at focusOffset with focusRadius corners when focused by keyboard.
Setting value from the application selects the tab without emitting valueChange.
In forced-colors mode the list's line, the selected tab's indicator and the focus indicator stay visible in system colors, and disabled tabs use the system disabled text color.
